title: MEIKO — The Evil Food Eater〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Now, shall we continue with our “meal”?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
Oh, where are my manners...?
Look at me, doing all of the talking.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. But allow me to tell you all about this pair of twin servants, as well as a certain cook. I promise not to disappoint♥

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Let us begin with the twins, Arte and Pollo...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: The girl, Arte, had a habit of declaring war on anything she disliked, but was a very capable servant and cook.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: The boy, Pollo, was much simpler and struggled to learn courtly manners, but had a much milder personality compared to his sister.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: They had been by my side since I was born, but they curiously never really aged as time went on.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: They ate very well too. Almost as much as I did. Strange, is it not...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: And I must not forget Josef the cook...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: It was quite delightful having all of us living in my manor together...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
A parasite-sausage dish...?
You added this to tonight's menu?

rows.Speaker: Josef
rows.Line: Y-Yes... You mentioned how it was far too bland last time, so I decided to make a few changes...

rows.Speaker: Josef
rows.Line: Bugs don't maintain their flavor well. To compensate, I made a sauce out of the shells of some poisonous bugs that I had to painstakingly peel off and grind up...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I have eaten quite a few poisonous bugs in my time, but a powder made out of their shells is indeed a new one...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Nicely done, Josef♥ I expect nothing less from such a great cook. Please, add it to tonight's menu.

rows.Speaker: Josef
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much.
If you'll excuse me, I need to go back to preparing.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. I simply cannot wait for dinner tonight...

rows.Speaker: Josef's Voice
rows.Line:
Arrgh!
What's a banana peel doing out here...?

rows.Speaker: Arte's Voice
rows.Line:
You fell for it again!!
What an idiot!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Everything Josef made was so unique and delicious...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Then, he gave me the greatest spice I could ask for...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I was blind to it at first, but I would soon realize that he was the one. My old flame.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: That night we spent together, as well as when we shared a meal while in my room...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Because of my deal with that demon, a sort of euphoric sensation came over me after tasting his poisoned soup.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: But my lover, Carlos, had some as well, so that we could die together...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Unfortunately, my contract prevented me from dying, while he soon passed away.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: But he left me the greatest ingredient of all.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: My “lover”. The only one in this entire world, and my sole opportunity to truly enjoy him...!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I would like for you to feel even just a fraction of the delight I felt that time...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: “They” may have been quite tasty as well...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, not Arte and Pollo.
There is no denying that they were very good.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: But before I knew it, there was nobody left in my manor except for me, my empty stomach and...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
There, there...
You can rest a while here.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
(Our baby...
Seeing you sleep always warms my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (And my stomach could not be emptier...)

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: You must consume this child or face death...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Yes. You must consume this child to save yourself. You must hurry...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: You will die if you do not!

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
Now, eat!
Without “food”, what would you have left?!

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: No, you must eat! Nothing else in this world will sate your lust for food!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I see something just as good... Right in front of me.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Do not be a fool! Stop! No!!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
I will consume myself.
Along with you, “demon”...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. I simply cannot wait to see how you taste♥

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: That will be it for today's “meal”...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I'm glad to see that you enjoyed everything as well.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Oh, are you wondering how I am still here even after I devoured myself...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: It really is quite strange, no?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
By the way...
My stomach is grumbling...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose anyone would feel hungry after hearing these kinds of stories.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: How would you feel about hearing another story of the like?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. Do not worry, satisfaction is guaranteed♥
